title: Appointed as Assistant
original: You're still not done assigning tasks? I'll wait a bit longer then.

title: Talk 1
original: Keep calm and carry on.

title: Talk 2
original: Our meals used to be fairly nice in the past... but the quality's gone downhill since we joined Indra's group.

title: Talk 3
original: I had a dream... a dream where the sun rises, and in the distance beyond the horizon... there was my hometown. The place I might never get to return to, ever again.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Before I knew it, I'd gotten accustomed to this drifter's life... It's a strange thing. In the past I never imagined this was how I'd end up.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Gawain and company? I wouldn't say they ran into me, more like they picked me up off the streets.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I used to stand side by side with Indra's team when we fought in the streets of Victoria... Looking back, I suppose it's a fairly fond memory to me.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Stay on your guard! I know you've done the best you can, but there may be unknown dangers beyond our abilities.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: If we're ever put in a tough situation... then I may well act on my own motives. And if it comes to that, Doctor, I hope you'll join me too in... no, never mind for now.

title: Idle
original: Hm? You fell asleep?... I wonder if you ever dream of your hometown, too.

title: Onboard
original: I've passed the strength test, right? So assign me some missions. Don't let this hammer get too bored. My codename? They call me the Siege. Curious name, but it's got a nice ring to it.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Feels pretty good.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Interesting...

title: Promotion 2
original: Another promotion? All right, thanks... Life is strange like that, you know? Once upon a time, I was the one assigning new ranks to people.

title: Added to Squad
original: Tell me, is this battle inevitable?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: You'd better get used to my combat style.

title: Depart
original: For want of a nail... the kingdom was lost.

title: Begin Operation
original: Run while you can. Better to be a coward with a pulse than a martyr with a grave.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Yes?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Are you ready?

title: Deployment 1
original: What a pain.

title: Deployment 2
original: We'll take them out all at once.

title: In Battle 1
original: My weapon chooses its worthy wielder.

title: In Battle 2
original: Get lost!

title: In Battle 3
original: A warrior must be ready to face death on the battlefield!

title: In Battle 4
original: My rule is the balance your lives hang in.

title: 4-star Result
original: Can bluff, can't take one blow.

title: 3-star Result
original: Those who refuse to surrender don't deserve mercy.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Are we done here?

title: Operation Failure
original: I'm... more tired than I thought. I apologize...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Do you mind if I get my forty winks in here?

title: Tap
original: Tsk...

title: Trust Tap
original: It's too noisy out there for my tastes... I think the silence of your office suits me more. Let me stay in here for a bit, will you?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: It's like I can hear an all-too-familiar chime again... I hope the new year's sun will be enough to tear through the hazy Londinium skies.

title: Greeting
original: Oh, it's you, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor. I look back fondly on the way I used to celebrate this sort of thing with Indra and the gang. We'd drink ourselves half to death, right on the street, and make a racket to match, but that doesn't seem so appropriate now... Still, I've got some lollipops on me. Want one?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Doctor, as a leader, do you ever find yourself confused too? Do you feel the same heavy burden when your choices can impact the fates of so many? I'm not one to flee from my duty, but there is so much that requires careful consideration... I may want some guidance from you.
